<insights>
- The Metropolitan City of Naples was established in 2015.
- Naples is the regional capital of Campania and the third-largest city in Italy.
- The metropolitan area of Naples is the second or third largest in Italy and one of the most densely populated cities in Europe.
- The province of Naples is the most densely populated in Italy.
- The metropolitan area of Naples had a population of approximately 3,700,000 to 4,250,000 in 2007.
</insights>
